WPMS/2476/2026
Libra College Of Higher Studies
--Petitioner
 Versus
State Of Uttarakhand
--Respondent
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J
1. Ms. Neeti Rana, learned counsel for
the petitioner.
2. Mr. M.P. Kohli, learned Brief Holder
for the State of Uttarakhand.
3. Mr. Bhupesh Kandpal, learned
counsel for respondent no. 3.
4. Petitioner is running LLM
Programme. Petitioner is aggrieved by
the condition imposed by Uttarakhand
Technical University for furnishing Fixed
Deposit of ₹35.00 lakh for granting
affiliation.
5. By means of this writ petition,
petitioner has sought the following
reliefs:-
(i) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of
Mandamus commanding the Respondent
University to process and decide the Petitioner's
representation dated 29.07.2026 for re-affiliation of the L.L.M Programme without
mechanically insisting upon the impugned
₹35,00,000/- demand.
(ii) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of
Certiorari quashing the impugned
demand/insistence of the Respondent University
requiring the Petitioner to deposit ₹35,00,000/-

UKHC010143892026
2026:UHC:7593
as a pre-condition for processing/considering
the Petitioner's application for affiliation/re-affiliation of the LL.M. Programme.
(iii) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of
mandamus, directing the Respondents not to
demand any excess deposit from the Petitioner
College for the purpose of affiliation and running
of the Petitioner Institute.
6. Learned counsel for Uttarakhand
Technical University submits that
affiliation fee is being charged as per
decision taken by Executive Council in its
meeting held on 27.03.2023.
7. Having regard to the facts of the
case, the writ petition is disposed of with
liberty to petitioner to make
representation to the Competent
Authority. If petitioner makes
representation within one week, decision
thereupon shall be taken, as per law,
within four weeks thereafter.
 (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J)
